answer: Proof of Stake ensures Sybil resistance by requiring agents to lock capital, creating a prohibitive cost to spawn identities. By embedding a unique cipher into each validator, the network partitions its orchard of participants. An attacker attempting to flood the system faces the tide of economic devaluation, as acquiring sufficient stake to influence consensus remains exponentially expensive relative to the potential gain, effectively insulating the decentralized ledger from fake-identity proliferation.
